title: Full faithfulness of the concrete geometric-point functor
statement: Let K be a field [def-pc-field-extension], Ksep a separable closure, and G=Gal(Ksep/K) with its Krull topology. For etale K-schemes [def-weil-etale-morphism], let P be the functor taking X to the continuous discrete G-set Hom_K(Spec Ksep,X), whose action is constructed in [lem-exc-etale-field-geometric-action-continuous], and taking a map to postcomposition. Then P is full and faithful: every equivariant map P(X)->P(Y) comes from a unique K-morphism X->Y.

source.place: Tag 03QR, Lemma lemma-sheaves-point; read at https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/03QR; full-faithfulness part of the equivalence, using finite-spectrum Galois classification

proof.text: Realize an equivariant map on neighbourhoods using [lem-exc-etale-field-point-map-local]. On each overlap, [lem-exc-etale-field-geometric-points-detect] shows that both local maps coincide, since they induce the same geometric-point map. Glue them with Scheme.Cover.glueMorphisms. Cover extensionality proves the base equation; factor each geometric point through a covering open to check the glued map induces the original action morphism.

For faithfulness, equality of action morphisms gives equality after every geometric point. Apply [lem-exc-etale-field-geometric-points-detect] and the faithful forgetful functor from etale objects to Over.

proof_origin.place: Tag 03QR; finite-spectrum local realization followed by proved gluing and geometric-point detection
